capabilities: Highlight, underline, and comment on PDF text with configurable styles
Explain, translate, and auto-annotate selected text using an OpenAI-compatible API
Draw stylus ink annotations with ruler, shapes, and eraser on mobile
Capture PDF regions and extract text via text layer or opt-in local OCR
Export all annotations and sticky notes to a Markdown note
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional OCR downloads its engine files once from jsDelivr; API keys are stored in the system keychain by default, with an opt-in plain data.json option. Annotation cross-device sync piggybacks on the user's existing vault sync (e.g. Remotely Save, iCloud) rather than syncing itself.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF handling has no annotation tools such as highlights, comments, handwriting, or AI assistance over selected text.

relations.evidence: Ruler (pen bar → ruler icon, Apple Notes style): tap to place an opaque, frosted-white ruler

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible AI endpoint (DeepSeek, OpenAI, or custom)

summary: PDF reader and annotation plugin with highlights, comments, stylus ink, screenshot OCR, and AI explain/translate/annotate via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
